acceptance.G0: Pinned source, exact protocol/reference SHA, immutable case except seed+name, HDF5 float64, exactly one complete level0 patch, 11 aligned timestamps, and 51200 macro particles at each snapshot
acceptance.G1_G5: The new real PHARE run must independently meet the same previous single-case conservation thresholds: 2 percent initial mode, N drift <=max(1e-12,8epsNmacro), Bx<=1e-12, momentum<=0.0032, compensated energy<=1.6e-5
acceptance.I0: Initial physically owned Bx/By/Bz fields must exactly equal the frozen seed314159 baseline owned arrays; any difference inconclusive, not a stochastic sensitivity fail
acceptance.I1: At least one initial particle position or velocity must differ from baseline, preserving same total particle count and global ion weight. Measure initial kinetic energy, momentum, deposited density RMS.
acceptance.S1: Maximum complex first Fourier harmonic new-vs-old /0.01 <=0.02 at all 11 times (absolute 2e-4)
acceptance.S2: Maximum initial-subtracted kinetic and transverse magnetic energy exchange differences independently /0.00032<=0.03 (absolute 9.6e-6)
acceptance.S3: Maximum initial-subtracted global ion momentum trajectory difference /0.064<=0.02 (absolute 0.00128)
acceptance.S4: Report observed two-seed differences beside preceding cross-grid differences, explicitly not partitioning grid error or estimating noise variance
acceptance.S5: After this single run and independent audit, hold a GO/NO-GO decision to shift to physical magnetic-obstacle model readiness. No open-ended seed campaign without a separately motivated reason.
